answer: Admission by burn-priced cohort auction. Each epoch the registry - the atlas of live identities - admits new keys up to capacity C, and the clearing fee F is burned, never escrowed. Lapsed keys become relics: slots are released, fees are gone, so registration is not a recoverable deposit. F = base + k*C rises with demand, so N puppets cost F*N with no bulk discount, an honest user pays F once; this velvet-rope pricing is enforced by the registry itself. Parallel reset fails: fees are unrecoverable and each key holds one atlas slot, so attacker cost grows linearly with n.
